// Note in these tests, the result is written exactly as expected
// Any same value would do - we test for the exact lexical form
// of the implementation.
@Test
public void round_01() {
    test("round(123)", "123");
}

@Test
public void testUnion() {
    testTransform(// SPARQL to Test
    "PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>
" + "PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
" + "        
" + "        SELECT ?sublect ?label
" + "        WHERE {
" + "            ?subject a  foaf:Person.
" + "            {
" + "                ?subject rdfs:label ?label .
" + "            } UNION {
" + "                ?subject <http://example.com/hasVcard> ?vcard .
" + "                ?vcard rdfs:label ?label .
" + "            }
" + "        } 
", // Target Op
    "(project (?sublect ?label)
" + "  (join
" + "    (bgp (triple ?subject <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#type> <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/Person>))
" + "    (union
" + "      (bgp
" + "        (triple ?subject <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label> ?label)
" + "        (triple ?subject <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#type> <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/Person>)
" + "      )
" + "      (bgp
" + "        (triple ?subject <http://example.com/hasVcard> ?vcard)
" + "        (triple ?vcard <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label> ?label)
" + "        (triple ?subject <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#type> <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/Person>)
" + "      ))))
");
}

@Test
public void testUnionWithOptional() {
    testTransform(// SPARQL to Test
    "PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>
" + "PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
" + "        
" + "        SELECT ?sublect ?label
" + "        WHERE {
" + "            ?subject a  foaf:Person.
" + "            {
" + "                ?subject rdfs:label ?label .
" + "            } UNION {
" + "                ?subject <http://example.com/hasVcard> ?vcard .
" + "                OPTIONAL {
" + "                   ?vcard rdfs:label ?label .
" + "                }
" + "            }
" + "        } 
", // Target Op
    "(project (?sublect ?label)
" + "  (join
" + "    (bgp (triple ?subject <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#type> <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/Person>))
" + "    (union
" + "      (bgp
" + "        (triple ?subject <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label> ?label)
" + "        (triple ?subject <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#type> <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/Person>)
" + "      )
" + "      (leftjoin
" + "        (bgp
" + "          (triple ?subject <http://example.com/hasVcard> ?vcard)
" + "          (triple ?subject <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#type> <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/Person>)
" + "        )
" + "        (bgp
" + "          (triple ?vcard <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label> ?label)
" + "          (triple ?subject <http://example.com/hasVcard> ?vcard)
" + "          (triple ?subject <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#type> <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/Person>)
" + "        )))))
");
}
